game.label: Your Star Command STARCOMA folder containing STARCOMM.EXE, SPACE.EXE and INFO.BAS.

exit_codes.1: Star Command could not start. Check that the selected game folder is available, the installation folder is writable, and Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome can start.
exit_codes.10: The launch arguments or browser selection are invalid. Check the displayed reason.
exit_codes.11: Select your STARCOMA folder in RecompLauncher, then press Play again.
exit_codes.12: Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome could not be found. Repair your browser, then press Play again.
exit_codes.13: Star Command is already running, or its saved port is in use by another program. Close the other session or program, then retry; the save address has not changed.
exit_codes.14: The local game server could not start. Check the displayed reason and retry.
exit_codes.15: The selected game folder could not be read. Check that its files are available and readable.
exit_codes.16: The browser profile could not be read or saved. Check that the installation folder is writable.
exit_codes.17: The game browser could not start or closed with an error. Restart the browser, then press Play again.
exit_codes.18: The saved server port is invalid. Restore recomp-profile/port from your backup to keep the same save address.
exit_codes.19: The game window could not be monitored. Check the displayed reason and retry.
exit_codes.20: Windows PowerShell could not be started. Repair Windows PowerShell, then press Play again.
exit_codes.21: The game browser could not close. Close its remaining processes before starting again.
exit_codes.9009: Windows PowerShell could not start. Repair Windows PowerShell, then press Play again.
